fire: The German army crossed the border into Belgium in August 1914.
Heavy fighting continued around Ypres in Flanders for months.
The river Meuse flows north through Namur and Liège.
The Battle of the Bulge was fought in the Ardennes in 1944.
Waterloo lies a few miles south of Brussels.
British troops held the line near Mons during the retreat.
The treaty transferred the province of Limburg to the Netherlands.
Allied forces advanced through Antwerp toward the Scheldt estuary.

The river Danube flows east through Vienna and Budapest.
